main.description: A subscribed RSS or Atom feed with a configured destination lexicon for imported entries.

url.description: The URL of the RSS or Atom feed.

title.description: Human-readable display name for this feed subscription.

destination.description: NSID of the target lexicon for imported entries (e.g. social.crate.podcast.episode).

active.description: Whether the poller should actively fetch this feed. Defaults to true.

lastPolledAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful poll.

lastEntryGuid.description: GUID of the last imported entry, used for deduplication on subsequent polls.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this feed subscription was created.
